step_by_step_reasoning: The whiteboard architecture shows medical images coming from hospitals to an initial Amazon S3 bucket (5TB). Pathologists (domain experts) interact with an Amazon EKS cluster hosting a Kubernetes labeling platform to annotate medical images. S3 data and EKS annotated data feed into Amazon SageMaker for model training. SageMaker uses Amazon FSx for high-performance file storage and AWS IAM for security and compliance. Trained models and output results are exported to a second Amazon S3 bucket (HDS compliant), which sends results back to the EKS platform for pathologist validation and inference.
